ov: مهمة مستحيلة 2 (الإنجليزية: Mission: Impossible II) هو فيلم حركة تم إنتاجه في أستراليا والولايات المتحدة الأمريكية سنة 2000 . وهذا الفيلم من بطولة توم كروز ودوجراي سكوت.
plotEn:
In Sydney, bio-genetics scientist Doctor Vladimir Nekhorvich sends a message to the IMF for Ethan Hunt, warning that his employer, Biocyte Pharmaceuticals, forced him to develop a biological weapon known as the Chimera virus to profit from its cure, Bellerophon. He injects himself with the virus, and departs for the CDC headquarters in Atlanta with the Bellerophon. En route, rogue IMF agent Sean Ambrose disguised as Hunt steals the Bellerophon and escapes, killing all aboard by crashing the plane into the Rockies. 
In Seville, IMF director Swanbeck informs Hunt about Ambrose's actions and tasks him with recovering Chimera and Bellerophon, and has him recruit Nyah Nordoff-Hall, a professional thief and Ambrose's ex-girlfriend. Despite her initial reluctance, Ethan gets her to trace Ambrose to Sydney using an injectable tracking device. Ethan assembles his team, old friend and computer hacker Luther Stickell, and helicopter pilot Billy Baird in Sydney while Nyah pretends to rekindle her relationship with Ambrose.
Ambrose uses a video of Chimera infecting one of Nekhorvich's colleagues to blackmail Biocyte's CEO, John McCloy, into cooperation. Nyah gives Ethan the memory card containing the video, revealing that Chimera has a 20-hour dormant period; Bellerophon is only effective if used within that window.
